sections.title: Derivatives and the Shape of a Graph

variables.meaning: the rate of change of the volume V of a balloon or of water with respect to time t, a related rate
the rate of change of the radius r with respect to time t, a related rate
the rate of change of a distance x with respect to time t, such as the speed of a plane
the rate of change of the distance s between two moving things with respect to time t
the rate of change of a height h with respect to time t, such as the rocket's speed or the falling water level
the rate of change of the angle θ of the camera with respect to time t, in radians per second
the linear approximation of f at x = a, the function L(x) = f(a) + f′(a)(x − a) whose graph is the tangent line
the limit of f(x) as x increases or decreases without bound, the level of a horizontal asymptote y = L
the area of a garden or of a rectangle, the quantity to be maximized as a function of one side length x
the volume of an open-top box, the quantity to be maximized as a function of the side length x of the square cut from each corner
the time it takes to travel from the cabin to the island, a function of the distance x along the shore
the revenue of a car rental company per day, a function of the price p per car
the surface area of a box with a square base, a function of the side length x of the base
the function that defines an iterative process, giving each number x_n = F(x_{n−1}) from the one before
an antiderivative of f, a function whose derivative F′(x) is f(x) for all x in the domain of f
the derivative of the antiderivative F, which is the function f
an antiderivative of g, or a second antiderivative of f
the rate of change V′(t) of the volume of air in a balloon t seconds after filling begins, the derivative of V(t)
the rate of change r′(t) of the radius of a balloon t seconds after filling begins, the derivative of r(t)
the angle between the camera lens and the ground, a function of the time t since the rocket was launched
the derivative of the area function A of an optimization problem, zero at its critical points
the derivative of the volume V(x) of the open-top box, zero at its critical points
the derivative of the travel time T(x) from the cabin to the island
the derivative of the revenue R(p) of the car rental company with respect to the price p
the derivative of the surface area S(x) of the square-based box
the derivative of the function G, equal to F′ when F and G are antiderivatives of one function
